name: Financial Capture 1 Code
definition: Mode for the financial capture of the transaction by the acquirer.

AUTH.name: Authorisation
AUTH.definition: Financial capture of the transaction is performed by the acquirer during the authorisation exchange.

COMP.name: Completion
COMP.definition: Financial capture of the transaction is performed by the acquirer during the completion exchange.

BTCH.name: Batch
BTCH.definition: Financial capture of the transaction is performed by the acquirer at the reception of a batch transfer.
